tldr_zh: OpenAI發布GPT-5.6 Sol改進版、Anthropic建立自主芯片團隊、Meta被罰$567M涉及兒童安全。
tldr_en: OpenAI upgrades GPT-5.6 Sol, Anthropic builds in-house silicon team, Meta fined $567M over child safety.

items.title_zh: OpenAI改進GPT-5.6 Sol並擴大免費用戶訪問權限
items.title_en: OpenAI Improves GPT-5.6 Sol and Expands Free User Access
items.summary_zh: OpenAI發布改進版GPT-5.6 Sol，提升準確度與一致性表現。同時擴大免費與Go版用戶的訪問權限，使其能進行無限文字對話。此舉意在降低高級AI模型的使用門檻。
items.summary_en: OpenAI releases improved GPT-5.6 Sol with better accuracy and consistency. The company expands access for free and Go tier users, allowing unlimited text chats with the chatbot. This move aims to democratize access to advanced AI models.

items.title_zh: Anthropic宣布建立自主芯片團隊加速AI推理
items.title_en: Anthropic Launches In-House Silicon Team to Advance AI Inference
items.summary_zh: Anthropic確認正在建立內部芯片設計團隊，旨在開發專有硅片以支持Claude模型推理。這是Anthropic和OpenAI為減少對英偉達芯片依賴、加速AI規模化所採取的競爭舉措，反映出大型AI公司對垂直整合的重視。
items.summary_en: Anthropic confirms plans to build an in-house silicon team to develop proprietary chips for Claude inference. This move reflects the race between Anthropic and OpenAI to scale AI while reducing dependence on Nvidia, marking a shift toward vertical integration in the AI industry.

items.title_zh: Google WeatherNext AI模型在颶風預報取得突破
items.title_en: Google DeepMind's WeatherNext Achieves Breakthrough in Cyclone Forecasting
items.summary_zh: Google DeepMind推出WeatherNext AI模型，在氣象預報領域特別是颶風預測上實現重大突破。該模型利用深度學習技術提升極端天氣事件的預報準確性，對防災與公共安全具有重要意義。
items.summary_en: Google DeepMind unveils WeatherNext AI model achieving breakthrough in cyclone forecasting. The model leverages deep learning to improve prediction accuracy for extreme weather events, with significant implications for disaster preparedness and public safety.

items.title_zh: Meta因危害兒童安全被罰$567M創歷史最高罰款
items.title_en: Meta Faces Record $567M Fine for Child Safety Violations
items.summary_zh: 新墨西哥州法官裁定Meta需支付$567M以應對其平台對兒童心理健康與安全造成的傷害，這是迄今針對社交媒體公司最大規模的兒童安全罰款。此判決凸顯政府對科技公司保護未成年人責任的加強監管。
items.summary_en: A New Mexico judge orders Meta to pay $567 million to address harms to children's mental health and safety on its platforms. This is the largest child safety ruling against a social media giant, reflecting increased government scrutiny of tech companies' responsibility to protect minors.

items.title_zh: AMD收購Taalas加強AI推理芯片設計能力
items.title_en: AMD Acquires Taalas to Boost AI Inference Performance
items.summary_zh: AMD宣布收購AI芯片新創Taalas，該公司專門將AI模型直接刻蝕到硅片中以優化推理性能。此舉是AMD在AI芯片競爭中的重要布局，旨在提升推理效能並降低延遲。
items.summary_en: AMD acquires Taalas to advance AI inference solutions by etching models directly into silicon. This acquisition strengthens AMD's position in the competitive AI chip market, enabling better inference performance and reduced latency for AI workloads.

items.title_zh: OpenAI與Jony Ive共同開發的AI智能音箱將售$300-400
items.title_en: OpenAI's AI Smart Speaker with Jony Ive to Cost Between $300-400
items.summary_zh: 根據報導，OpenAI與蘋果前設計師Jony Ive合作開發的AI設備是一款無顯示屏的電池供電智能音箱，形狀似冰球，預計2027年上市售價超過$300。該產品代表科技巨頭在AI硬體領域的戰略擴展。
items.summary_en: OpenAI's AI device designed with former Apple designer Jony Ive is a battery-powered, hockey puck-shaped smart speaker without a display. Expected to launch in 2027 at a price over $300, this product signals major tech companies' strategic expansion into AI hardware.

items.title_zh: Suno推出水印與下載限制政策遏制AI音樂濫用
items.title_en: Suno Implements Watermarking to Combat AI Music Spam
items.summary_zh: AI音樂生成平台Suno宣布推出新的水印技術與下載政策以限制垃圾AI音樂傳播。CEO強調公司致力於提高透明度與合法性，建立AI音樂生成的責任框架。
items.summary_en: Suno announces plans to implement watermarking technology and download policies to limit spam AI-generated music. The company aims to increase transparency and establish accountability in AI music generation, addressing concerns about misuse.

items.title_zh: Amazon開源多代理工具Kiro Crew 已獲3.9萬員工採用
items.title_en: Amazon Open-Sources Kiro Crew Multi-Agent AI Tool
items.summary_zh: AWS宣布將內部專案MeshClaw改名為Kiro Crew並開源。該工具允許多個AI代理跨開發階段持續處理任務，並保存狀態與上下文。在6個月內已獲39,000名Amazon員工採用，證明其在提高開發效率中的價值。
items.summary_en: AWS announces the open-sourcing of Kiro Crew, an internal tool enabling multiple AI agents to collaborate across development tasks while preserving context. Adopted by over 39,000 Amazon employees in under six months, it demonstrates significant productivity gains.

items.title_zh: FCC廢除廣播電台所有權上限規則　放寬媒體集中管制
items.title_en: FCC Ends Broadcast Ownership Cap Rule in Historic Deregulation
items.summary_zh: 美國聯邦通信委員會投票廢除廣播電台國家所有權上限規則，結束多十年的媒體所有權限制。此舉允許廣播公司擴大市場控制力，引發關於媒體集中與言論多元化的爭議。
items.summary_en: The FCC votes to end the national broadcast ownership cap rule, eliminating decades of restrictions on media consolidation. This deregulation allows broadcast owners to expand their control, raising concerns about media concentration and diversity of voices.

items.title_zh: Meta遭指控危害兒童心理健康 被新墨西哥法院處以$942M罰款
items.title_en: Meta Ordered to Pay $942M for Child Mental Health Harms
items.summary_zh: 新墨西哥州法院判決Meta支付$942M以應對其社交媒體平台對兒童造成的心理健康傷害。此為針對科技公司保護未成年人最大規模的法律制裁，反映全球監管機構對平台責任的提高要求。
items.summary_en: A New Mexico court orders Meta to pay $942 million to address harms to children's mental health caused by its social media platforms. This largest penalty represents heightened government accountability for tech platforms protecting minors.

items.title_zh: 烏克蘭深入俄領空襲擊兩座油煉廠 削減戰爭資金來源
items.title_en: Ukraine Strikes Russian Oil Refineries Deep in Mainland Territory
items.summary_zh: 烏克蘭總統表示，烏軍對俄羅斯領土深處的兩座油煉廠發動襲擊，目的是切斷俄方用於戰爭融資的石油收入。此舉體現烏克蘭戰場戰略從防禦轉向主動攻擊俄國經濟命脈的升級。
items.summary_en: Ukraine's president announces strikes on Russian oil refineries deep within mainland territory aimed at cutting off revenues funding the war. This represents an escalation of Ukraine's strategy targeting Russia's economic war-financing infrastructure.

items.title_zh: 川普簽署行政令限制出生公民權並禁生育旅遊
items.title_en: Trump Signs Executive Orders Restricting Birthright Citizenship and Fertility Tourism
items.summary_zh: 美國總統川普簽署行政命令，擴大不適用出生地公民權的定義並禁止生育旅遊。此舉反映川普政府強硬移民政策立場，將引發憲法與法律爭議。
items.summary_en: President Trump signs executive orders narrowing birthright citizenship eligibility and banning fertility tourism. These measures reflect the administration's hardline immigration stance and are expected to trigger constitutional and legal challenges.
